summary: Four churches, one parish: weekend, weekday, Confession and Wednesday Adoration times are printed in the page 1 box and agree in the six bulletins read. First Friday and first Sunday St. Jude Masses are weeks-of-month slots (First Friday kept under R12 from the Sep 27 issue). Dated: Nov 17 Mass of Remembrance at St. Amelia; the Nov 2 All Souls Mass is at a St. Francis chapel not on the church list. No open questions.
